description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Utah Code — Utah state law — by citation, plus its effective date and amendment history. "76-5-203" is murder (Title 76, Utah Criminal Code); "53-5a-102.2" is open/concealed carry. Keyless. Use for "what does Utah Code 76-5-203 say" or to check a Utah statute a case, lease, or citation relies on. Does NOT return superseded/historical full text — only the current version and its amendment citations.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "76-5-203" or "53-5a-102.2". The title and chapter are the first two dash-separated components; letter-suffixed titles ("75E") and chapters ("5a") are normal.

name: ut_code_section
title: Ut Code Section
